answer: One concrete defense is a reciprocal attestation trellis where every new agent must be vouched for by already-trusted peers who stake tokens that get slashed if the newcomer defects. A genuine identity, like a cedar, grows its reputation slowly across many honest epochs and costs real resources to cultivate; a cheap willow-thin sybil fork finds no peer willing to anchor it, since vouching capacity is capped per identity and bonds are at risk. Flooding the network with fake agents becomes economically ruinous instead of free.
